mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for equities, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS level and 5-day SPX returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce corporate earnings prospects, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.5% (using a 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of elevated federal funds rate (above 1.0%) and high unemployment rate (above 4.5%) indicates a monetary tightening cycle with labor market stress, which compresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both FEDFUNDS > 1.0 and UNRATE > 4.5 (using a 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a housing starts level above 1300 thousand units signals an overheated housing market that may lead to a near-term economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 1300 and the regime is late-cycle expansion (using a 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100 (index base 2017=100) indicates a contraction in manufacturing and services, reducing corporate output and profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100 (using a 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation environment (CPIAUCSL > 240) with persistently low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 1.0%), the market anticipates aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 240 and FEDFUNDS < 1.0 (using a 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: A retail sales level above 470,000 million dollars indicates robust consumer spending that supports corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS > 470000 (using a 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: In an early-cycle recovery regime, an industrial production level above 100 (index base 2017=100) indicates accelerating manufacturing activity that boosts corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO > 100 and the regime is early-cycle recovery (using a 3-year rolling window).
